delta: The tripping of the Atacama solar generator strains transmission flows toward the central demand center, presenting a direct choice between maximizing economic and emission savings through dual battery deployment versus minimizing overall line loading through emergency corridor ratings.

diagnosis_es: Sudden outage of the Atacama solar plant has overloaded the Norte-Centro transmission corridor without interrupting consumer supply. No available operating move improves the residential shortfall under the current grid constraints.

options.rationale_es: Delivers the largest operating cost savings and decarbonization impact by leveraging full energy storage support across both zones.
Keeps transmission corridor loading significantly lower while avoiding heavy utilization of the northern battery storage assets.
